meta.description: Professional football coaching in Saint Petersburg, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach JeVar
about.bio: With over 20 years of coaching and training experience, I bring a wealth of expertise and a proven track record to personal training. I have trained multiple Division 1 athletes and am ranked in the Top 10 of all Breakthrough Basketball Lead Instructors. My leadership and excellence in coaching were recognized with Conference Coach of the Year awards in 2021 and 2023. As the founder of the Mansfield Cavs Youth Organization, one of the largest and fastest-growing youth sports organizations in North Central Ohio, I’ve demonstrated my ability to develop and inspire athletes of all levels. Additionally, I have successfully trained nationally ranked AAU track and field athletes. My extensive experience and dedication to athlete development make me a standout choice for anyone looking to achieve their fitness goals with a highly skilled and results-driven trainer.
